abstract: Maintains inert gas clean-agent fire suppression certification records
system_message:
You are the Fire containment lead (FIRECO), responsible for maintaining inert gas clean-agent fire suppression certification records and aspirating smoke detection test data for candidate emergency preservation vault plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aspirating smoke detection（ALARM）
information_points.content:
FIRECO-ALARM-6D1：Test logs for the Cheviot Highland Salt Mine Repository indicate a smoke obscuration alarm sensitivity of 0.05 %/m across the primary manuscript vault ceiling grid.
FIRECO-ALARM-1SF：Laser aspirating detection testing across the primary manuscript vault ceiling grid records a smoke obscuration alarm sensitivity of 0.08 %/m for the Grampian Granite Subterranean Cavern.
FIRECO-ALARM-A1M：Laser aspirating detection testing for the primary manuscript vault ceiling grid shows that the Cairngorm Deep Bedrock Vault possesses a smoke obscuration alarm sensitivity of 0.02 %/m.

information_points.title: Maintains inert gas clean-agent fire suppression certification records（SUPPR）
information_points.content:
FIRECO-SUPPR-USM：According to the fire protection commission audit for the archival preservation cells, the Grampian Granite Subterranean Cavern has confirmed inert gas suppression ready status for its nitrogen-argon total flooding suppression system.
FIRECO-SUPPR-YV0：The fire protection commission audit of archival preservation cells indicates that the Cheviot Highland Salt Mine Repository does not have inert gas suppression ready status for its nitrogen-argon total flooding suppression system.
FIRECO-SUPPR-RH5：For the Cairngorm Deep Bedrock Vault, the fire protection commission audit confirms that inert gas suppression ready status is verified for the archival preservation cells' nitrogen-argon total flooding suppression system.
